svg.title: Native SCL status: observation and single-clear matched pairs
svg.desc: Two fresh observation sessions sampled status five at the last delivered frame, immediately and at the complete EOS delivery barrier. Two fresh clear sessions each wrote the observed mask five once and sampled zero immediately and at EOS. Every diagnostic session delivered all 180 baseline-identical scaled frames. Original diagnostic failure remains failure; no general clear semantics, fresh-work or source-lifetime claim.

g.text: Native SCL: sampled status after one clear attempt
BCM70015 · MPEG-2 640×360 → 320×180 YUY2 · two fresh matched pairs
Each node: two status samples, each bracketed by REV 0x80; non-atomic observations.
All 4 diagnostic captures: native pixels / 180 frames / EOS / cleanup PASS
Diagnostic + aggregate: FAIL retained, including after sampled status becomes zero
20,736,000 bytes each, byte-identical to the frozen normal downscale; no missing frame.
Not proved: universal W1C or timing, stale-only cause, fresh-work fault absence, raw-source lease.
Test-only opt-in; no production clear, retry, geometry, clock, plane-address or firmware changes.
